tagline.en_US: Receive notifications from scripts and services through Gotify clients and its web interface. ProxMenux generates a unique initial administrator password.

description.en_US: Gotify is a self-hosted server designed for sending and receiving push notifications in real time. It enables clients to send messages through a REST API and receive them via WebSocket connections. The platform includes tools to manage users, clients, applications, and plugins through an integrated web interface.
